verified_behaviors: Platform persists a claimed run before dispatching the immutable runtime request
Runtime rejects unknown fields, invalid bindings, duplicate JSON keys and unauthorized requests
Platform and Runtime calculate the same canonical execution request hash
Runtime sends running stage events, one terminal succeeded event and final publication
Publication uses the latest site row version returned by the Platform event API
Tokens and callback URLs are not included in the execution request payload
remaining_boundaries: durable runtime submission queue and worker adapter
service principal provisioning and runtime deployment
